title: noccaea dolichocarpa
intro: Noccaea dolichocarpa, commonly known as Alpine penny-cress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea dolichocarpa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit anti-arthritic, anti-ulcerative, and anti-diabetic activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
